name: Thunder Tribunal Usurper
lore: A Hollow entity that stole the Olympian divine tribunal's authority. It wields a corrupted thunderbolt of anti-light and stands before an empty throne. The marble columns of the tribunal orbit it, each one consumed and dissolving.
visualDescription: 50-60ft Hollow entity in corrupted Greek divine armor and helmet. Anti-light thunderbolt. Empty marble throne behind. Floating broken marble columns. Gate stone in chest. Mount Olympus base.
mapBehavior: Boss encounter — 4 phases: thunderbolt attacks, column summon, throne shield, stolen ability phase
